   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.09.2026 - 10.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _I C_, 10.10.2026, 1/5: "I would love to love this app, unfortunately it simply doesn't work on my phone. I crashes when I try to create a new document and it crashes when I try to open one too. What a shame :("
            2. _Mein Name_, 03.10.2026, 1/5: "completely useless if in spreadsheets lines do not stick together when sorting. It's also buggy as hell. When I tap "freeze row" nothing happens. And for some reason it keeps overwriting while I am typing. a complete mess but I would have still used it if I could sort my data correctly."
            3. _Monitor ePublications AR_, 25.09.2026, 2/5: "Won't open password protected files as of 9-26, prior to that usually stable. Known new issue, awaiting fix."
